# PostCompare.eu

> Free, independent and open-source comparator of European postal rates. Compare stamp, letter and parcel prices (domestic and international) of the national postal operators of 32 countries: EU27 + EFTA (CH, NO, IS, LI) + United Kingdom.

Prices are collected manually from the operators' official websites. Prices from non-euro countries are converted to EUR at the exchange rate of the collection date. Displayed prices are indicative: always check the operator's official website.

## Pages

Each page exists in French (/fr/), English (/en/) and German (/de/).

- [Home](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/): overview and list of the 32 covered countries
- [Comparator](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/compare/): compare letter or parcel prices by weight, origin and destination country
- [Rankings](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/rankings/): cheapest and most expensive postal operators (average domestic letter and parcel prices, with purchasing-power adjustment)
- [2027 postal rates](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/tarifs-2027/): officially announced 2027 changes (stamp, letter and parcel prices) with effective dates and sources
- [Operator pages](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/operator/la-poste-fr/): detailed rates per operator at /{lang}/operator/{operator-id}/
- [About](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/about/): methodology and neutrality
- [Contribute](https://www.postcompare.eu/en/contribute/): how to report or fix a price
- [Sitemap](https://www.postcompare.eu/sitemap-index.xml)

## Open data

Source code and data (MIT licence): https://github.com/alo-is/postcompare

- data/operators/{operator-id}.yaml: one file per operator with domestic and international letter rates (by zone) and domestic and international parcel rates (by zone), prices in EUR
- data/postal-changes-2027.yaml: officially announced 2027 postal rate changes, with sources
- data/countries.yaml: covered countries (names in fr/en/de)
- data/exchange-rates.yaml: exchange rates used for non-euro currencies
- data/price-level-index.yaml: Eurostat price level indices used for purchasing-power adjustment

## Operators

- Austria: Österreichische Post (osterreichische-post-at)
- Belgium: bpost (bpost-be)
- Bulgaria: Български пощи (balgarski-poshti-bg)
- Croatia: Hrvatska pošta (hrvatska-posta-hr)
- Cyprus: Cyprus Post (cyprus-post-cy)
- Czechia: Česká pošta (ceska-posta-cz)
- Denmark: PostNord (postnord-dk)
- Estonia: Omniva (omniva-ee)
- Finland: Posti (posti-fi)
- France: La Poste (la-poste-fr)
- Germany: Deutsche Post (deutsche-post-de)
- Greece: ELTA (elta-gr)
- Hungary: Magyar Posta (magyar-posta-hu)
- Iceland: Íslandspóstur (islandspostur-is)
- Ireland: An Post (an-post-ie)
- Italy: Poste Italiane (poste-italiane-it)
- Latvia: Latvijas Pasts (latvijas-pasts-lv)
- Liechtenstein: Liechtenstein Post (liechtenstein-post-li)
- Lithuania: Lietuvos paštas (lietuvos-pastas-lt)
- Luxembourg: POST Luxembourg (post-luxembourg-lu)
- Malta: MaltaPost (maltapost-mt)
- Netherlands: PostNL (postnl-nl)
- Norway: Posten Norge (posten-norge-no)
- Poland: Poczta Polska (poczta-polska-pl)
- Portugal: CTT (ctt-pt)
- Romania: Poșta Română (posta-romana-ro)
- Slovakia: Slovenská pošta (slovenska-posta-sk)
- Slovenia: Pošta Slovenije (posta-slovenije-si)
- Spain: Correos (correos-es)
- Sweden: PostNord (postnord-se)
- Switzerland: La Poste Suisse (la-poste-suisse-ch)
- United Kingdom: Royal Mail (royal-mail-gb)
